jobs.title: Environmental Health Safety Coordinator
jobs.description:
Environmental Health & Safety Coordinator

Temporary

Lodi, CA

$34/hr

*Position is fully onsite in Lodi

*Schedule:
Regular schedule is Monday–Friday during standard business hours; the position may occasionally require swing-hour coverage
to support EHS activities and events, such as the team’s annual hearing testing

Kelly is seeking an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Coordinator to work with our client, a leader in the biotech industry, on a long-term temporary basis (12+ months) in Lodi. This is an excellent opportunity to join a collaborative EHS team supporting a 24/7 operation, providing critical coordination and program support to help maintain a safe, compliant, and well-supported workplace.

The Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Coordinator will:

Coordinate workers’ compensation claim activities, including claim reporting, follow-up on associate work status, tracking restrictions/accommodations, return-to-work updates, case documentation, and related follow-up items
Partner with HR, LOA, workers’ compensation providers, managers, and EHS team members to support timely case updates, communication, and coordination
Provide administrative support for EHS programs, including safety glasses, safety shoes, respiratory fit testing, training coordination, and other assigned programs
Schedule and coordinate EHS meetings, trainings, appointments, program activities, and associate check-in/logistics for EHS-related appointments
Maintain and organize EHS communication resources, training materials, program libraries, files, supplies, and program areas in an audit-ready manner
Support EHS event planning, including coordination of materials, communications, scheduling, and logistics
Assist with EHS-related inspections, document findings, track corrective actions, and follow up with action owners to support timely closure
Track open EHS action items and proactively communicate with responsible owners to help drive completion
Prepare reports, summaries, metrics, data updates, and records for EHS programs and leadership review
Support purchase requisitions, supply ordering, purchase order tracking, expense reporting, and budget tracking for EHS-related activities
Support additional EHS tasks, projects, and initiatives as assigned

Qualifications:

3 years of experience in Environmental, Health and Safety, workers’ compensation coordination, HR/LOA support, or administrative program coordination; OR

Bachelor of Science degree in Environmental, Health and Safety or a related field

Required Qualifications

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and follow-up items
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with associates, managers, HR, external providers, and cross-functional partners
Experience maintaining records, tracking open actions, preparing reports, and managing data accurately
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint
Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. and perform work that may involve standing, sitting, walking, and repetitive arm/wrist motions

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with workers’ compensation claim coordination, return-to-work processes, LOA administration, or occupational health support
Experience supporting EHS programs, compliance tracking, training coordination, or inspection follow-up
Experience in a manufacturing, laboratory, medical device, biotechnology, or other regulated environment
Strong Excel, SharePoint, and data reporting skills
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to follow up with stakeholders and help drive timely completion of action items
